comment: Legacy duplicate ids grandfathered by the board id gate (QA-GITREINS-POC-8). These rows predate the producer-side fix in hermes-dagger examples/coding-hermes/qa.ts (ids continue after the highest suffix in use) and are append-only history: they are never renumbered. Counts are asserted by scripts/check_board_ids.py, so the baseline can only shrink deliberately, in the same commit as the board change that makes an entry stale.
